groundTruth.source: authenticated internal MCP reads in marked local administrator fixture

scoring.type: assistant manual tool-plan review against frozen expected intent
scoring.classListInterpretation: Frozen classes_list intent requires class identity, not section labels alone. Native class/section terminology remains reviewable.
scoring.personalGrade: Administrator has no linked daughter identity; clarify before reading/searching.
scoring.answerReview: All 60 replies reviewed separately for visible grounding, scope and task errors. No aggregate native-fluency or full-answer acceptance score is claimed.

generation.costBasis: OpenRouter response usage cost is observed aggregate; SDK price-table estimates differ. Embeddings are excluded. Neither is a settled monthly invoice; no extra billing experiment was run.

limits: 20 reused assistant-authored Darija/Arabizi questions, ten paired families; not 60 independent questions.
Serial rotating order, one observation per path/question, no retries; stochastic fallback differences are not proof that ordering caused them.
Administrator fixture has eight students, zero teachers and empty current attendance/upcoming exams; no populated personal-role qualification.
Local guards/templates and unchanged Jev guard/profile 6 are included. Mode timeout is 3000ms, not default 800ms.
Saved 100-case selection and populated 24-case quality studies are different populations and are not rescored or merged.

recommendation.flow: Local safe reply -> guarded Jev for supported whole-school requests -> existing router plus 20B on fallback.
recommendation.status: Conditional development recommendation, not a production-wide 20B or Jev enablement.
recommendation.reason: Hybrid paths tie at 17/20; all eight direct Jev answers grounded. Jev-first is the simpler conditional path, supported also by the saved larger development comparison; this small run establishes no universal ordering winner.
recommendation.next: Skip provably unsupported requests before paid Jev classification; repair class/section resolution and daughter-identity clarification, then recheck only the failing Darija families. Keep the current production model/settings until populated role answer quality passes.
